system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: nightmare realms and places where prophetic dreams recur. Dreamthorn is a leafless silver briar that appears in nightmare realms and places repeatedly visited by prophetic dreams. Its thorns reflect sleepers rather than their surroundings, each tiny image showing a different expression or age. A single thorn is steeped in water until it vanishes, and the draught is consumed before entering a trance lasting 1 hour. Before the trance, ask one question concerning a goal, event or course of action likely to occur within the next week. During the prophetic dream, the GM provides a truthful answer, although it may be brief or symbolic. After benefiting from Dreamthorn, you are temporarily immune to it for 1 week. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
